ENVIRONMENT  (--clearenv, then:)
  HOME             /home/u                         (snug)
  LOGNAME          u                               (snug)
  PATH             /opt/control                    merge     hostlinkmarks
                   /opt/hostlink/bin               merge     hostlinkmarks
                     ← writable from inside
                   /opt/hostlink2/x                merge     hostlinkmarks
                     ← cannot tell where this lands (a host path on the way
                       cannot be read)
                   /usr/bin /bin /usr/sbin /sbin   (snug)    base
  PS1              🔒 snug:\w\$                     (snug)
  SHELL            /usr/bin/bash                   (snug)
  SNUG             1                               (snug)
  SNUG_PROFILES    @home,@sys,@target-rw,hostlinkmarks (snug)
  SNUG_TARGET      /home/u/proj/sub                (snug)
  TMPDIR           /tmp                            (snug)
  USER             u                               (snug)
  XDG_CACHE_HOME   /home/u/.cache                  set       @home
  XDG_CONFIG_HOME  /home/u/.config                 set       @home
  XDG_DATA_HOME    /home/u/.local/share            set       @home
  XDG_STATE_HOME   /home/u/.local/state            set       @home
  PWD              /home/u/proj/sub                (bwrap)   --chdir
                     ← bwrap sets this from --chdir; snug does not
